snippet.title: Jenny LeClue Detectivu - Official 5th Anniversary Accolades Trailer | Now on iOS! #apple #nintendo
snippet.description:
Tiny Detective. Big Mystery.

Jenny LeClue - Detectivu is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character. Featuring dozens of characters to meet, mysteries and puzzles to solve across a vibrant, atmospheric world.

Available now on
iPhone: http://ios.jennyleclue.com
Switch: http://switch.jennyleclue.com
Steam: http://steam.jennyleclue.com
